text:
maya (Product): Quick thread: customer requested private pilot for tenant-scoped pinning + soft quotas. Need minimal cross-team gates to schedule. @noah @cheng @lisa

sam (PM): Minimal: pin/unpin API, per-tenant usage telemetry, soft token caps with alerts, and audit trail. No full dedicated tenancy for initial pilot.

noah (Runtime): Runtime list: tenant pin state, per-tenant cache namespace, fallback to shared model with metric. Estimate: 2 sprints if infra provides capacity. Need API schema.

cheng (Infra): We can carve shared GPUs with reservation labels. Prewarm toggle needs a small controller change; ETA ~8 business days. Need product approval for reserved slot.

lisa (Security): Pilot ok with KMS-backed keys (soft-HSM). Must enable audit logs for pin/unpin and key access. I'll post checklist later today.

tara (SRE): Ops needs tenant-dim dashboards and alerts for quota throttle and fallback rate. We can reuse route dashboards with a tenant tag.

maya (Product): Acceptance criteria (pilot): POST/DELETE pin API, soft-enforce quota with webhook alert, tenant p95 latency + token usage, KMS keys + audit, reserved slot + prewarm, ops runbook. Confirm?

noah (Runtime): Confirmed. I'll add OpenAPI fragment once sam posts spec.

cheng (Infra): Confirmed reservation pending product sign-off. I'll open infra ticket and link here.

lisa (Security): Ack. Posting checklist shortly.

sam (PM): I'll produce the 1-pager + rollout (2 tenants -> 5 -> 15) and API sketch by EOD. If infra locks slot this week we can schedule runtime work next sprint.

maya (Product): Thanks. If any blocker, flag in this thread; otherwise we meet Mon 15m for final go/no-go.
